data.name: Rishi
data.gender_notes: Rishi is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Rishi is recorded with the meaning “Seer, Sage, Scholar”. Rishi is a Hindu name meaning “Seer, Sage, Scholar”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.

in_hindi.name: रिषि
in_hindi.long_meaning: One who sees or perceives the form of things

in_marathi.name: Rishi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Seer, Sage, Scholar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rishi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A person who has gained knowledge and insight through deep meditation and contemplation. One who has realized the ultimate truth and can guide others on their spiritual journey.

in_bengali.name: Rishi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Seer, Sage, Scholar
in_bengali.long_meaning: Rishi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A person who has gained knowledge and insight through deep meditation and contemplation. One who has realized the ultimate truth and can guide others on their spiritual journey.
